name: Graft
text:
Decision: We should build a single, living “memory map” document that links every key idea we’ve discussed—people, tools, goals, and open questions—using plain-language summaries and clear relationships. This forces us to turn vague memories into explicit, connected nodes, which is the fastest way to build a usable brain graph.

Trade-off: It takes time to write and maintain, but that upfront cost is outweighed by the long-term recall savings. We accept some extra effort now to avoid the far greater pain of forgotten threads later.
